title:
A clearer start
for every request.
narration: Meet Management Agent, a classifier for condominium resident requests.
It turns a message into a category, priority, and suggested team.

cues.text: Meet Management Agent, a classifier for condominium resident requests.

title: Start with the resident's words.
narration: A resident reports a flickering corridor light. Staff enter the message and, optionally, its location.

cues.text: A resident reports a flickering corridor light. Staff enter the message and, optionally, its location.

title: A decision staff can inspect.
note: A model score is not validated accuracy.
narration: The classifier identifies maintenance and suggests the maintenance team.
The model score stays visible, and uncertain requests are flagged for review.

title: Bring urgent reports to a person.
narration: A child trapped in a lift triggers an emergency flag before any model call.
The app prompts human action; it does not dispatch help.

title: Work through a small inbox.
note: Suggestions only. No tickets are created.
narration: Staff can upload a CSV inbox, inspect the classifications, and export the results.

title: Measure before expanding.
note: Includes safety rules. Real-world accuracy is unverified.
narration: The starter workflow classified fifty three of fifty five synthetic examples correctly.
This is a development check, not real resident accuracy.
